---
title: "Course dataset: FLUID-ICU"
---

::: {.simulated}
**Simulated data — not real patients.** FLUID-ICU is an invented study: every value was produced by a computer program with a fixed random seed. It does not describe any real patient, hospital or ICU. Any manuscript written from it must say that the data are simulated and must never be submitted as real research.
:::

FLUID-ICU is a simulated multicentre prospective cohort of **620 adults with sepsis** admitted to 4 ICUs ("ICU A" to "ICU D") from January 2023 to December 2024. It carries the course's running example into Sessions 5–8: *is a positive cumulative fluid balance by day 3 associated with higher 28-day mortality?* The data were built so that the classic lessons show up in the results: **confounding by indication** (sicker patients receive more fluid and die more often, so the crude odds ratio is clearly larger than the adjusted one), **missing data** (lactate missing in about 15%), a **skewed outcome** (ICU length of stay) and an **interaction** worth discussing (heart failure). A raw version with realistic data-quality errors is used in the Session 5 cleaning demo.

Each of the five groups answers a different question on the same data and writes it up as its draft manuscript, using its **results pack** (Table 1, figures, regression tables and plain-language notes).

## How the analyses are run

**Participants never need to run anything:** in Sessions 5 and 6 the trainers run the R scripts live (block by block in RStudio) and you read the printed outputs and your group's results pack. The scripts are provided for participants who completed the free Neudata course *Clinical Data Analysis in R* and want to reproduce the analyses: unzip the R project, open `FLUID-ICU.Rproj` in RStudio (it sets the working folder) and run the scripts **in order**. Script `01_clean.R` ends by checking that its output equals the clean file value for value. Script `00_generate_fluid_icu.R` re-creates the simulated data (course team only; it overwrites the data files with the same values, because the seeds are fixed).

```bash
cd Course/Data      # or the folder where you unzipped FLUID-ICU_R_project.zip
Rscript R/01_clean.R          # S5 demo: raw -> clean; checks the result equals the clean file
Rscript R/02_describe.R       # S5 demo: Table 1 + histogram, boxplot, bar chart
Rscript R/03_compare.R        # S6 demo: t-test, Mann-Whitney, chi-square
Rscript R/04_models.R         # S6 demo: crude vs adjusted OR, forest plot, KM, Cox, interaction
Rscript R/05_missing.R        # S6 demo: missing lactate, complete case vs multiple imputation
Rscript R/06_results_packs.R  # (course team) rebuilds the results packs
```

R 4.3 or later with these packages:

```r
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "janitor", "writexl", "readxl", "gtsummary", "gt",
                   "flextable", "officer", "broom", "survival", "survminer", "mice"))
```
